obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: The flatness criterion requires integral source and target, finite and dominant actual f, and Dedekind section rings on the cover.
obligations.constructed_input: CompletedCharacterFinite318.completedMap_finite, CompletedCharacterProper318.completedMap_dominant/target_proper_integral and actual model_integral supply these exact objects.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Target chart rings must be the whole actual rings, not normalizations merely sharing an equation.
obligations.constructed_input: ShortAffineJacobian318.Ring A B and InfinityChart318.Ring A B are literally the charts in WeierstrassGluing318.
obligations.justification: ShortAffineJacobian318.Ring A B and InfinityChart318.Ring A B are literally the charts in WeierstrassGluing318.

obligations.name: Index and domain coverage
obligations.required_input: All four original characters and every point of each completed target must be covered.
obligations.constructed_input: i:Fin4 is unrestricted; WeierstrassGluing318.charts_cover splits every p into the two actual opens, and preimage_nonempty covers the actual source restriction.
obligations.justification: i:Fin4 is unrestricted; WeierstrassGluing318.charts_cover splits every p into the two actual opens, and preimage_nonempty covers the actual source restriction.

obligations.name: Dimension and exceptional coefficients
obligations.required_input: Dedekind needs dimension at most one, Noetherianity, domain and full normality, without excluding vanishing A or B.
obligations.constructed_input: The finite chart is integral over Q[x]; infinity over Q[z] through a monic cubic in x. Only the original unit discriminant is required for whole-chart normality; quotient Noetherianity and integral dimension descent supply the rest.
obligations.justification: The finite chart is integral over Q[x]; infinity over Q[z] through a monic cubic in x. Only the original unit discriminant is required for whole-chart normality; quotient Noetherianity and integral dimension descent supply the rest.

obligations.name: Exact comparison maps
obligations.required_input: The ring flatness theorem must apply to the actual f.app U and actual target restrictions.
obligations.constructed_input: Scheme-theoretic dominance gives actual app injectivity. The specific algebra is (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra. restrict_flat_iff uses actual appLE_congr and the exact top-open identities; sections_dedekind uses the actual ΓSpec/open-immersion equivalence.
obligations.justification: Scheme-theoretic dominance gives actual app injectivity. The specific algebra is (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra. restrict_flat_iff uses actual appLE_congr and the exact top-open identities; sections_dedekind uses the actual ΓSpec/open-immersion equivalence.

obligations.name: Flatness inference
obligations.required_input: Torsion-freeness must be established for the actual module over each Dedekind section ring.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual injective algebra map into domain gives Module.IsTorsionFree, and the pinned Dedekind torsion-free-flat theorem gives Module.Flat. Integral source and nonempty preimage are retained.
obligations.justification: Actual injective algebra map into domain gives Module.IsTorsionFree, and the pinned Dedekind torsion-free-flat theorem gives Module.Flat. Integral source and nonempty preimage are retained.
